name: users/services/__init__.py
summary: Package-level facade that exposes AuthService and UserService to provide a unified import interface for the users domain services.
purpose: Decouples consumers from internal module file structure by aggregating user domain services at the package boundary, enabling stable and simplified imports throughout the application.
responsibilities: Expose AuthService as a public package-level symbol
Expose UserService as a public package-level symbol
Provide a stable import interface independent of internal submodule organization
Aggregate user domain services under a single namespace
architecture_notes: Implements a package-level Facade pattern to create a clean public API for the services layer. This abstraction insulates upstream consumers from internal file restructuring and centralizes the service surface area. It aligns with the Dependency Inversion Principle by allowing higher-level modules to depend on a stable package interface rather than concrete implementation modules.
improvements: Define __all__ to explicitly control public exports and prevent namespace leakage
Add a module-level docstring clarifying the service aggregation intent
Consider lazy import patterns if service classes trigger heavy side effects or circular dependencies
Add explicit re-export type annotations for improved static analysis and IDE support
